# INSIGHTS — summarized, verified findings (accumulate across the whole run)

The JOURNAL is your per-iteration diary; THIS file is the distilled, VERIFIED takeaway a future iteration should read instead of re-reading the whole journal or old sessions/traces. Update it whenever you have a genuinely NEW, confirmed finding (an accepted/rejected RESULT counts as confirmation; a guess does not) — not every iteration needs a new entry. Structure each addition as:

    ## <task or mechanism name>
    - What worked (confirmed by a RESULT, cite the candidate id):
    - What didn't (confirmed by a RESULT, cite the candidate id):
    - Promising but not yet tried:

## Composite modify tool for the cabin/flight/passenger/baggage cluster
- What worked (confirmed by a RESULT): cand_0001's in-body guards (payment auto-correct,
  baggage recompute, cancel-flown) + narrow payment_summary + targeted policy — ACCEPTED,
  val 0.450 (cand_0001).
- What didn't (confirmed by a RESULT): an ADDITIVE composite (`change_cabin`) that leaves
  the raw primitives exposed — REJECTED, val 0.417, broke={} (cand_0002). The tool was
  DB-correct; leaving the primitives in place let the model keep using the path that
  corrupts the flights arg, so the fix never bound. Additive-and-optional is too weak here.
- Promising but not yet tried (shipped in cand_0003, RESULT pending): REMOVE the three
  update primitives via REMOVE_TOOLS and expose ONE mandatory `modify_reservation`
  (cabin+flights+passengers+baggage, segments reused verbatim on cabin-only) + a read-only
  `quote_change`. Live-verified to reproduce the gold DB hash for 11/12/17/22/37 and to be
  read-only for quotes. Adapter note: REMOVE_TOOLS filters at the get_tools boundary
  (`_build_candidate_tools`), and hidden methods remain callable for internal delegation —
  verify against the adapter, not the raw module.
